dict.Tragi punctele și mânerele; click pe lin: Drag the points and handles; click on the line: new point; Shift+click: several points; Ctrl+click a point: remove it; Ctrl+drag on the line: move the path; Alt+click a point: corner / smooth.
dict.Traseu: click pune un colț, click și tra: Path: click places a corner, click and drag places a smooth point (smooth curve); click the first point to close the path, Enter leaves it open; then make it a selection, stroke it or fill it. Finished path: drag the points and handles, click on the line adds a point, Shift+click selects several points (dragged together), Ctrl+click a point removes it, Ctrl+drag on the line moves the whole path, Alt+click a point makes it corner / smooth. Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels
